doc.title: Jack DeJohnette interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 7, 2025

title: Personal archive of recordings
summary: He has an archive organized by his wife and assistant in several tape formats.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Do you save — let me rephrase, I’m sort of surrounded here by a number of your LPs and CDs and I’m wondering if you have a personal collection of Jack DeJohnette recordings? Do you save everything that you do?

Yeah as a matter of fact I have an archive, my wife and my assistant Joan Clancy spent quite a lot of time organizing for me. But you know I recorded in different formats: cassettes, DATs, reel-to-reel. Anyway you were going to ask me about favorite albums?
